learning_outcomes.text: Identify the characteristics and properties of different materials applied in engineering.
Examine the different methods of processing and shaping materials.
Evaluate processing methods, according to their suitability with discrimination ability.
Review the development of new materials and technologies.

assessment_rules: Continuous evaluation consists of practical assignments (10%), article presentation (10%), a partial exam (45%), and a final exam on units 3 & 4 (35%). To pass via continuous evaluation, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for the partial exam and lab practices. Students who do not participate in continuous evaluation or do not meet minimum requirements will take a final exam (100%). Continuous evaluation is only available in the ordinary call; for extraordinary calls, students must take a final exam. Exams will include multiple-choice questions and development questions.
